counts_for: R1 rounds only; R1 is judged on a later pre-registered confirmation evaluation, registered only if a round passes on all ten seeds
motivation: session 7 closed after three warm starts from r19 (rows 32-34: 0, 2 and 6 of 10). The prompt gives the operator's measurement of the training logs: r20, r21b and r22 fell to about +1.1 to +1.3 reward per step by iteration 30 at sigma 0.30, 0.30 and 0.12 and ended below r19's +4.47, while r18 and r19 (themselves warm starts at sigma 0.30) did not fall below their opening level, and r17 (fresh) was still at its best at iteration 751 of 760. It states ADR-471 and that the critic is not carried, and names no remedy: the agent chooses the revision (a fresh start, a warm start, a task or mechanism change)

driver.change: since session 7 (was 72ea8c62): a start the trainer refuses before its first iteration (attempt: false) is not counted as a session run (commit f7d131d4)

spec_block.mechanism_rule: byte-identical except the values of HIP_MM and WEIGHT_N, which must equal the evaluated model's rig.hip_height_mm and rig.weight_n as the evaluation report states them (to the block's printed precision); SPEC_LIFT keeps its formula

mechanism.agent_may_change: geometry, bodies, collision shapes and per-body contact settings, joints and limits, actuators, and the parameters that set them, through the ordinary edit and accept path
bounds: four legs on one free base; the spec's feet stay c_foot_fl, c_foot_fr, c_foot_rl, c_foot_rr
the floor body and its plane, and every global physics setting (timestep, gravity, solver), unchanged
actuators stay catalog parts at catalog limits
no contact margin or gap on any shape; cadex evaluate voids every seed of a model that has one (ADR-470)
mechanism.actor_changes: none: the project is as the agent's session-7 turn left it; the prompt states the warm-start training measurements and ADR-471, and no remedy

warm_start: allowed by the trainer only from a policy on the same model and the same observation/action layout; since ADR-471 a warm start continues at the source's exploration.log_std unless initial_std is set; the critic and optimiser state are not carried. The agent chooses whether to warm-start at all

engine.source: the dev tree at bcb92f12 (src/Mod/cadex, cli/cadex_cli and training/ last changed at e6360889)
engine.rule: nothing under src/Mod/cadex, cli/cadex_cli, training/ or build/ changes while the session runs

driver_args: --max-runs 3 --max-turns 3: per session; the ledger holds 23 train_ended rows before this session (one of them r21's refused start), which the driver records as runs_ended_before

per_run.budget_reason: raised from session 7's 2400 s so a fresh start can run past r19's 750 iterations (about 2,010 s): r17, the last fresh start in the lineage, was still at its best reward at iteration 751 of 760. loop.MAX_BUDGET_S (21,600 s) is unchanged
per_run.seed_rule: the product agent chooses it at train_start; train_start refuses any of 1101-1110
per_run.registered_by: train_start writes runs/<run>/registration.json and a train_registered ledger row before launch

wall_clock_bound: 3 turns; at most 3 runs of at most 3600 s each (10,800 s GPU at most); one GPU job at a time (machine training lock)
stop_rule: an evaluation passes on every seed, or 3 runs of this session have ended and been evaluated (re-evaluations and refused starts count for nothing), or 3 turns have ended
supervision: rounds.py under setsid, outliving the actor's session; each training run under its own cadex_cli.loop supervisor
after: after each evaluation: the spec block is compared under mechanism_rule, contact_offsets must be empty, and the model digest, hip height and weight are recorded; a difference voids that evaluation. If an evaluation passes all ten seeds, a confirmation evaluation is pre-registered and committed before it is run
